arxiv-2012-11465.creator: Giulia Di Nunno giulian@math.uio.no, Yuliya Mishura myus@univ.kiev.ua, Anton Yurchenko-Tytarenko antony@math.uio.no
arxiv-2012-11465.description: Abstract We study a stochastic differential equation with an unbounded drift and general Hölder continuous noise of an arbitrary order. The corresponding equation turns out to have a unique solution that, depending on a particular shape of the drift, either stays above some continuous function or has continuous upper and lower bounds.

arxiv-2304-14129.description: Abstract The advent of gravitational wave astronomy has seen a huge influx of new predictions for potential discoveries of beyond the Standard Model fields. The coupling of all fundamental fields to gravity, together with its dominance on large scales, makes gravitational physics a rich laboratory to study fundamental physics.

pmc-11356043.title: Elastomeric Compositions of Ethylene–Norbornene Copolymer Containing Biofillers Based on Coffee and Tea Waste
pmc-11356043.creator: Aneta Malicka, Kamila Rułka, Malgorzata Latos-Brozio, Anna Masek, Philippe Evon, Niclas Solin
pmc-11356043.description: The development of eco-friendly elastomeric materials has become an important issue in recent years. In this work, thermoplastic elastomer samples of an ethylene–norbornene copolymer (EN) with coffee and tea biofillers mixed with typical fillers such as montmorillonite (MMT), silica (SiO2), and cellulose were investigated.

pmc-11488669.title: Validity and Reliability of the Amharic Version of EORTC QLQ‐OG25 Among Esophagogastric Cancer Patients in Ethiopia
pmc-11488669.creator: Lidya Genene Abebe, Abigiya Wondimagegnehu, Eva Johanna Kantelhardt, Adamu Addissie
pmc-11488669.description: BackgroundCancers of the stomach and esophagus are the fourth and sixth most common causes of cancer‐related deaths worldwide, respectively. Although various tools have been developed to assess the quality of life of patients with esophagogastric cancer, EORTC QLQ‐C30 and EORTC QLQ‐OG25 are the most used all over the world. However, they have not been validated in an Ethiopian context.

pmc-11596041.title: Evolutionary Analysis and Antiviral Drug Prediction of Mpox Virus
pmc-11596041.creator: Zhong-Hao Lian, Chen-Hui Yang, Ye Qiu, Xing-Yi Ge, Francesco Broccolo
pmc-11596041.description: The resurgence of mpox virus (MPXV) poses a significant challenge to global public health. Currently, there is a limited understanding of the evolutionary details of MPXV during its epidemics, and no specific drugs have been developed for it. Herein, analysis of mutations and positive selection sites (PSSs) within the MPXV genomes revealed 799 mutations and 40 PSSs.

pmc-11670475.title: Psychometric evaluation and community norms of the PHQ-9, based on a representative German sample
pmc-11670475.creator: Sören Kliem, Cedric Sachser, Anna Lohmann, Dirk Baier, Elmar Brähler, Harald Gündel, Jörg M. Fegert
pmc-11670475.description: BackgroundThe Patient Health Questionnaire (PHQ-9) is a popular tool for assessing depressive symptoms in both general and clinical populations. The present study used a large representative sample of the German adult population to confirm desired psychometric functioning and to provide updated population norms.

pmc-12118273.title: Recent progress in low‐swellable polymer‐based smart photonic crystal sensors
pmc-12118273.creator: Yong Qi, Shufen Zhang
pmc-12118273.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Low‐swelling polymers (LSPs) generally refer to materials with a low solvent absorption ratio or volume expansion rate at swelling equilibrium. LSPs with exceptional responsiveness could be upgraded to smart sensors with structural color self‐reporting by bridging photonic crystals (PCs).

pmc-12358521.title: Exploring the shared genetic basis between autism spectrum disorder and gastrointestinal disorders: a bioinformatic study
pmc-12358521.creator: Mahdi Malekpour, Mohamad Parhizkar, Fahimeh Golabi, Rachel Thompson, Mohammed Al Zakwani, Saeed Soleymanjahi, Elnaz Chohedri
pmc-12358521.description: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental disorder with early-appearing social communication deficits and repetitive behaviors. ASD is associated with various comorbidities, including gastrointestinal (GI) conditions. This study aims to identify shared genetic mutations between ASD, inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), and celiac disease through bioinformatics, to uncover mechanisms contributing to GI issues in ASD patients.

pmc-12413565.title: Metabolic Reprogramming: A Crucial Contributor to Anticancer Drug Resistance
pmc-12413565.creator: Yunhan Zhu, Weijie Yan, Lingfeng Tong, Jie Yang, Shengfang Ge, Jiayan Fan, Renbing Jia, Xuyang Wen
pmc-12413565.description: Cancer metabolic reprogramming is a fundamental hallmark that enables tumor cells to sustain their malignant behaviors. Beyond its role in supporting growth, invasion, and migration, metabolic rewiring actively contributes to anticancer drug resistance. Cancer cells not only reshape their own metabolism but also engage in aberrant metabolic crosstalk with nonmalignant components within the tumor microenvironment (TME).

pmc-12438782.title: Self-protective behaviours to protect against coronavirus-19 infection and their association with Perceived Infectability, Germ Aversion and Fear of COVID-19 among South African learners
pmc-12438782.creator: S. Mashegoane, J. O. August, V. Baloyi, L. D. M. Lebeloane, M. Makhubela, K. P. Moalusi
pmc-12438782.description: IntroductionCOVID-19 wreaked havoc across the world killing millions along its path. All attempts were made to lower and eventually control the death toll from the pandemic. The “trace, test and treat” approach had its limits since the latter were not developed fast enough. Vaccines were seen as the best hope to protect individuals from the coronavirus and COVID-19.

pmc-12587695.title: PRRS management by European swine veterinarians: a descriptive insight into practices and profiles
pmc-12587695.creator: Charlotte Teixeira Costa, Arnaud Lebret, Stéphanie Bougeard, Nicolas Rose
pmc-12587695.description: BackgroundDespite extensive research on porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome virus (PRRSV), herd-level management strategies vary considerably according to geographical area and depend significantly on many factors. Swine veterinarians play a key role in PRRS management; however, their practices, perceptions, and decision-making processes remain insufficiently described.

pmc-12589033.title: Design of debunking the frailty–sarcopenia–ADT axis in metastatic prostate cancer with multicomponent exercise: the FIERCE trial protocol
pmc-12589033.creator: Rebekah L. Wilson, Anderson Vulczak, Alicia K. Morgans, Mary Norris, Jocelyn Greer, Jennie Votta, Maria Vamvini, David J. Einstein, Hajime Uno, Michael Rosenthal, Matthew G. Vander Heiden, Christina M. Dieli-Conwright
pmc-12589033.description: IntroductionThe incidence of metastatic prostate cancer (mPCa) is increasing despite a decrease in the prevalence of prostate cancer (PCa). Androgen deprivation therapy (ADT), the mainstay of systemic treatment for mPCa, is associated with numerous side effects, including a decline in muscle mass and physical function, which lead to the exacerbation of age-related frailty and sarcopenia.

pmc-12716497.title: Function of follicular helper 17 T cells in driving B cells for anti-DNA autoantibody production in patients with SLE
pmc-12716497.creator: Tipanan Khunsri, Pachara Tianpothong, Piyawan Kochayoo, Pongsakorn Thawornpan, Thanitta Suangtamai, Chaniya Leepiyasakulchai, Pintip Ngamjanyaporn, Prapaporn Pisitkun, Patchanee Chootong
pmc-12716497.description: BackgroundFollicular helper T (TFH) cells play a crucial role in the dysregulated antibody responses in SLE. Circulating TFH17 (cTFH17) subsets are elevated in active lupus, and their frequency is associated with increased disease activity and autoantibody levels, indicating their potential role in disease development by promoting B-cell and autoantibody production.
